title: A scheme with finite discrete underlying space is affine
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] whose underlying topological space is finite and discrete (every subset of $X$ is open). Then $X$ is an affine scheme: the canonical morphism $X\to\operatorname{Spec}\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] (corresponding to the identity of $\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$) is an isomorphism.
